section.name: Permissions and duties of the IAB
section.t: The Internet Architecture Board (IAB) serves as the supreme constitutional appeal and oversight body under . The IAB's jurisdiction over active document streams is strictly bounded by deterministic, non-extendable procedural timer events.

Upon the filing of a formal appeal, the IAB Secretariat MUST enforce a strict, unalterable maximum three-week (21 days) response window for the targeted functional body to deliver its official response matrix. Any technical evidence submitted to the file MUST be categorized as integral background context material and MUST be unedited and fully disclosed to the public archive immediately upon the expiration of the 21-day evaluation window, ensuring a complete and unalterable audit trail.
